biggest_catch: You must be accepted as a vetted mentor, and bookings depend on client demand — income is fully variable.
catches: Must pass mentor vetting — not everyone is accepted.
A platform service fee applies to paid sessions; confirm the current rate before publishing yours.
Bookings depend on demand for your stack; income is fully variable.
The '$2500+ per week' line on the page is a testimonial anecdote, not a typical outcome.

c1.evidence: Codementor's own mentor page states: 'Set your own rate and provide live 1:1 mentorship' and 'Set your hiring availability and express interest in projects' — a real, public expert-services marketplace.

c2.evidence: Official page publishes no fixed pay range — mentors set their own rates; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: apply, set rate/availability, get booked or express interest in projects, deliver, get paid.

c4.evidence: Applying as a mentor carries no upfront fee.

eligibility: Developers with demonstrable expertise who pass Codementor's mentor application.
notes: Scenario: dev niche (mentorship + freelance projects). Codementor lets vetted developers sell live 1:1 mentorship at their own rate and bid on freelance projects. Acceptance and bookings are competitive; income is variable — never guaranteed.
numeric_basis: payout: mentor-set rates, no official fixed range. time: application + profile/rate setup + first availability listing, est. 45-90 min active.
payout_quote: Set your own rate and provide live 1:1 mentorship to help fellow developers on your own schedule.
payout_value_note: Mentors set their own rates; Codementor publishes no fixed pay range — variable per-session/per-project income.

steps: Apply to become a vetted expert mentor (application review; Codementor cites 5,000+ vetted expert mentors).
Set your own rate, schedule, and availability.
Get booked for live 1:1 mentorship sessions (screen share, video, text) or set hiring availability and express interest in freelance projects.
Deliver sessions or project work; Codementor handles payment processing with timely payouts.
timing: On your own schedule; clients book sessions as demand arises.
